questions.subject: GERMAN
questions.topic: What a German application pack contains
questions.learningObjective: List the contents of a German application pack
questions.stem: In the clinician's note on a job application, what does a German application pack typically contain?

options.text: A Lebenslauf, Anschreiben, and Zeugnisse
Only a short email with no attachments
A single CV page with no cover letter
A portfolio of creative work only

questions.explanation: A German application pack contains a Lebenslauf, an Anschreiben, and Zeugnisse. The other options omit required documents or confuse formats.

provenance.author: bank-team-german
provenance.attestation: authored from first principles; no protected content used

questions.subject: GERMAN
questions.topic: Direction of a German Lebenslauf
questions.learningObjective: State the direction of a German Lebenslauf

stimulus.body: The clinician's note reviews a CV that lists the most recent job first and older jobs below. The layout follows the usual German order.

questions.stem: In the clinician's note on a nurse's CV, what is the direction of a German Lebenslauf?

options.text: Chronological from oldest to newest
Alphabetical by employer name
Reverse chronological from newest to oldest
Random order by relevance

questions.explanation: A German Lebenslauf runs reverse chronologically, newest first. The other orders reverse, sort, or randomise the entries.

provenance.author: bank-team-german
provenance.attestation: authored from first principles; no protected content used

questions.subject: GERMAN
questions.topic: The claim made in an Anschreiben
questions.learningObjective: Identify the claim in an Anschreiben
questions.stem: In the clinician's note on a cover letter, what claim does an Anschreiben typically make?

options.text: It demands a specific salary outright
It requests personal references only
It lists every grade from school
It states motivation and fit for the role

questions.explanation: An Anschreiben states motivation and fit for the role. The other options overstate demands, list grades, or narrow the purpose.

provenance.author: bank-team-german
provenance.attestation: authored from first principles; no protected content used

questions.subject: GERMAN
questions.topic: Register when asking a superior for a favour
questions.learningObjective: Choose the right register for a favour
questions.stem: In the clinician's note on a request to a senior doctor, explain the register used when asking a superior for a favour.

answer.exemplar: When asking a senior doctor for a favour, the clinician uses a formal register with 'Sie' and polite phrasing such as 'Könnten Sie bitte', avoiding casual 'du' and direct commands.

questions.explanation: A formal register with 'Sie' and polite phrasing suits a superior. Casual forms or commands would be inappropriate.

provenance.author: bank-team-german
provenance.attestation: authored from first principles; no protected content used

questions.subject: GERMAN
questions.topic: Contract clause against administrative detail
questions.learningObjective: Spot the contract clause on admin detail
questions.stem: In the clinician's note on an employment contract, which clause speaks against excessive administrative detail?

options.text: The clause that limits paperwork to essentials
The clause that adds more forms to fill
The clause that sets a dress code
The clause that fixes working hours

questions.explanation: The clause that limits paperwork to essentials speaks against excessive admin detail. The others reverse intent or confuse topics.
questions.hint: Look for a limit on paperwork.

provenance.author: bank-team-german
provenance.attestation: authored from first principles; no protected content used

questions.subject: GERMAN
questions.topic: Answering the salary question in an interview
questions.learningObjective: Answer the salary question appropriately
questions.stem: In the clinician's note on a job interview, how should one answer the salary question?

options.text: State a fixed demand with no flexibility
Refuse to discuss salary at all
Give a range based on market rates
Ask the interviewer to name a number first

questions.explanation: A range based on market rates is appropriate. Fixed demands, refusal, or deflection are less suitable.

questions.subject: GERMAN
questions.topic: Prepositions for a span of time
questions.learningObjective: Choose prepositions for a time span
questions.stem: In the clinician's note on a shift schedule, which preposition marks a span of time?

options.text: 'um' marks an exact hour
'in' marks a single point in time
'an' marks a specific day
'von ... bis' marks a span of time

questions.explanation: 'von ... bis' marks a span of time, while 'in', 'an', and 'um' mark point, day, or hour. The distinction is fixed.
